questions.question:
SECTION 1:
Choose the option (A–D) that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to the focus word that correctly fills the gap.
What should have been a source of motivation for him proved a terrible source of ______.
The government has been spending more money on preventive rather than on curative medicine.
Too many theories will not help us; we need to be practical.
Nobody expects him to have hatred for his children but he certainly bestows too much affection on them.
Emmanuel complained that while his colleagues were elevated, he was downgraded.
In many ways my parents are very conservative but there are times when they surprise me with their liberal ideas on family planning.
The rather insignificant effort he made yielded absolute results.
At the end of the crisis, the leaders declared that there was neither victor nor vanquished.
Bala was vocal in protesting against high-handedness of the police unlike Sani who was mute.
The government has ______ an embargo on further recruitment of staff but lifted that of appointment.
The play was so interesting that the audience clapped for quite a long time at the end.
Many people reacted to the brutal murder of the popular journalist with strong condemnation.
After his defeat in the war, the General disbanded his army and went into retirement.
The notorious robber was finally arrested by the police after a three-month search.
The earthquake that struck Mali demolished the city.
He was fortunate to have escaped unhurt from the collapsed building.
The local government election was cancelled because of widespread irregularities during voting.
Many students had good results in the examination but Abel’s performance was woeful.
We returned home late in the night because our car had a break down.
Cosmetics are sometimes used to cover the defects of nature.

SECTION 2:
Choose the option (A–D) that best completes each sentence.
Kunle is very unconvinced about our chances of success.
The execution of the projects has been hindered by lack of funds.
The boss has an aversion for smoking.
The government has set aside a large sum of money for the construction of feeder roads.
The champion was admired for his tenacity.
He was kept in solitary confinement.
Chinua Achebe is a renowned novelist.
The task before us is great.
The outcome of the matter has justified my earlier stand.
As soon as Abbas realized that he had made a mistake, he did everything to correct it.

SECTION 3:
Choose the interpretation that best explains the meaning of each sentence.
The student’s plans amount to building castles in the air. This means the plans are ______.
Femi passed his examinations with flying colours. This means he ______.
options: B. wore cloth of different colours

questions.question: The peace meeting nipped the crisis in the bud. This means the crisis was ______.
Since I found out his hypocritical nature, I have been keeping him at arm’s length.
options: A. avoid being familiar with him

questions.question: The driver smelt a rat when the policeman asked him to stop.
The amount he donated was small. He said it was his widow’s mite.
options: D. he could have given more

questions.question: From the way Mercy behaves, it is obvious she is a greenhorn.
The friendship between Segun and Shehu has turned sour. This means they are ______.
The debating team was warned not to play to the gallery.
The workers suspect that the boss has a skeleton in his cupboard.

SECTION 4:
Choose the most appropriate option (A–D) to fill each numbered gap in the passage.

questions.passage: Learning the regions of the body and the ______ of the organs within these regions can help you better understand the human ______. Diagram of the human body and anatomy can help you chart these organs and place them within the different ______ of the body. It is important to remember that each organ ______, the organs and ______ thereof, and even the ______ parts of the body, such as ______, all play an important role throughout the human body. Learning the anatomy of the ______ body is important in learning how to take ______ of yourself and maintain a ______ plan for the care of your body and its important ______ organs.

questions.question:
SECTION 5:
Choose the most appropriate option (A–D) to fill each numbered gap in the passage.

questions.passage: I made a visit to the University Teaching Hospital the other day. At the ______ department, where accident ______ are treated, the doctors were battling to save the life of a man who had just been knocked down in a road accident. They ______ the injured man thoroughly with the aid of several ______ instruments such as the ______ used in measuring body temperature and the ______ used in listening to the sound of the heart and the lungs. By using ______, several internal parts of the patient’s body were filmed. Anti-tetanus and pain-killing injections were given. His bleeding was stopped. The nurse ______ his wounds and he was carried on a stretcher to the special unit ______ where those under intensive care are kept.
